title: Push Notification Consolidation
subtitle: Unifying scattered entry points into one clear admin flow
summary: Admins couldn't tell what state a push was in. I'm redesigning MyLoyal's scattered push entry points into one unified flow, with status visible at every stage from draft through sent.

problem.statement: Sending a push notification from the MyLoyal admin panel was confusing and low-confidence for admins. Pushes could be sent from multiple different places, and there was no clear way to see what stage a push was at.
problem.bizCtx: The admin panel had grown to allow sending pushes from several different touch points, without a consistent way to track a push's status once it was created. That hesitation undermined a core tool for client engagement.
problem.constraints: Multiple existing entry points for sending pushes needed to be reconciled into one consistent flow without breaking existing admin habits.

findings.finding: Admins couldn't tell what stage a push was at
findings.evidence: No consistent status indicator across the different places pushes could be sent from.
findings.implication: A single, clear status system visible regardless of entry point.

findings.finding: Multiple entry points created inconsistent experiences
findings.evidence: Each touch point handled the sending flow slightly differently.
findings.implication: Consolidate entry points into one unified flow.

insight.decision: One unified flow with status visible at every stage, regardless of where the admin starts. Status clarity leads the design; consolidation supports it.

design.solution: A consolidated push notification flow with a single, clear status system visible at every stage, replacing the previous scattered entry points.
design.flows: Admins create and send a push through the unified flow, with status clearly visible at each step from draft through sent.
design.annotations: Confidence comes from clear, consistent status visibility rather than an added approval step, which was deliberately left out of the design.

outcome.shipped: Still in development. The consolidated flow and status system have been designed.
outcome.measures: Not shipped yet; the measures the design should be held against once live: time for an admin to create and send a push, mid-flow abandonment, whether status questions from admins disappear, and whether the unified flow fully replaces the old entry points in practice.
outcome.learnings: Consolidating the scattered entry points surfaced the real problem: inconsistent status reporting was undermining admin confidence even more than the number of entry points itself.
